headline: Working on design systems and digital modernization for Canadian Blood Services
bio: I've been building digital interfaces for 25 years. I started when the web was new, and I've worked through every major shift since.

I'm a believer in systems. A well-crafted one does more than keep design consistent. It settles arguments, speeds people up, and outlasts whoever built it. Most of what I do is that: taking something tangled and making it make sense for the people who use it — across a whole product, not one screen at a time.
Agentic workflows are the newest shift, and I'm approaching them with equal parts curiosity and caution.
